title: The Pale Lake
rumor: The Pale Lake. Deep within the mountains lies a still subterranean lake whose waters shine faintly even in complete darkness. Travelers claim to see reflections of unfamiliar stars upon its surface, though no opening to the sky exists. A dwarven account describes a stone landing on its shore, where boats once waited for passengers who never returned.
first_lead: An old Blackpick mining record mentions an underground waterway with similar properties.
